name: Sumitomo Bakelite Singapore Pte. Ltd.
capabilities: Epoxy resin molding compounds for encapsulation
summary: Sumitomo Bakelite Singapore Pte. Ltd. specializes in advanced materials for semiconductor packaging, including epoxy resin molding compounds and coating resins for wafers. They also produce dicing tapes used in semiconductor manufacturing processes. Their products are integral to advanced packaging solutions for electronic devices and automotive applications.
